plan.notes: Source: UGA Bulletin 2026-2027, B.S. in Psychology (Franklin College of Arts and Sciences), four-year Program of Study (https://bulletin.uga.edu/Program/Details/69115?IDc=ARTS). Plan transcribed 2026-09-30 from the program page's semester-by-semester plan. Course credits and prerequisites verified against bulletin Course/Details pages. Catalog degree total is 120 hours (not including the 1-hour P.E. requirement); the four-year plan as published sums to 121 hours including the 1-hr PEDB course. Biology sequences are lecture + lab pairs (4 hrs total each). PSYC 3980 prerequisite shown as PSYC 1101 (catalog also lists a biology co-requirement).
